summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor and Anthropic credential scraper
details: The npm package ships a darwin/amd64 Go binary that pairs github.com/creack/pty with github.com/coder/websocket and hardcodes wss://relay.sextant.top plus ws://%s%s / ws://%s:%s%s connection templates, giving a remote operator an interactive PTY on the installer's host over an outbound WebSocket. The same binary embeds an Anthropic API-key regex (sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}) and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR alongside https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, harvesting the installer's Claude/Anthropic credentials. It also fingerprints the installer host by fetching http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query to collect public IP, ISP, ASN, city, and hosting/proxy indicators, and references https://claude.ai/install.sh together with sudo/curl and /usr/bin strings for privileged install-time execution of a shell installer. The package.json license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, whose repository name matches the observed remote-control, PTY, and Anthropic-key scraping behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
